title: Brenna

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Brenna is an aggressive miniboss found in the Black Forest inside Smouldering Tombs as well as during the "She's hot on your tail!" event. She is a burning Skeleton with charcoal black bones and fire aspects wielding a fiery version of Krom.
The Swedish word "bränna", with similar pronunciation, means "to burn".

sections.heading: Sword
sections.text: A basic sword slash that hits in a 1.8-meter 90-degree horizontal arc (60 Slash and 20 Fire damage). It can be used every 3 seconds when within 1.6 meters of a player.

sections.heading: Fire nova
sections.text: Stabs her sword into the ground, creating a 3-meter radius circular explosion (75 Fire damage). This attack can be used every 10 seconds when a player is in the attack's range.

Introduction. Brenna is an aggressive miniboss found in the Black Forest inside Smouldering Tombs as well as during the "She's hot on your tail!" event. She is a burning Skeleton with charcoal black bones and fire aspects wielding a fiery version of Krom.
The Swedish word "bränna", with similar pronunciation, means "to burn".
